messages.subject: Follow-up | Strategic Value Creation Brief for Wood
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Traynor,

Following my earlier introduction to Wood, I prepared a concise strategic value brief focused on Wood's growth and delivery agenda across the Middle East, Africa and Caspian.

The paper addresses government and institutional alignment, local-value delivery, energy-transition stakeholder positioning and cross-market execution. These are areas where my operating experience across government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive coordination may support Wood's regional priorities.

My executive CV is included in the final three pages. I would welcome a confidential discussion regarding country-facing or regional leadership needs across government relations, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, sustainability or related functions.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com
linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for Wood
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Wood enters a new ownership phase as part of Sidara while carrying strong momentum across the Middle East, where recent awards span gas processing, petrochemicals, decarbonisation, asset performance and strategic advisory. This combination creates an execution agenda that depends on more than engineering excellence. It requires disciplined government engagement, local-content delivery, stakeholder alignment, community confidence and cross-functional follow-through across multiple jurisdictions. My director-level experience in regulated resources, government relations, ESG, corporate affairs and strategic partnerships would support Wood by strengthening these interfaces and connecting external commitments to accountable project and country execution.
strategic_brief.company_context: In March 2026, the court sanctioned Sidara's acquisition of Wood, marking a major ownership and leadership transition. At the same time, Wood's Middle East platform entered the year with strong commercial momentum after more than $1 billion of regional contract wins in 2025 across the UAE, Iraq, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman and Qatar. The portfolio includes ADNOC's Habshan expansion, West Qurna 1 support, the TA'ZIZ methanol facility and decarbonisation work across Iraqi oil fields. Wood has also positioned Gerry Traynor within global gas and LNG industry dialogue through the Gastech 2026 Executive Committee. These priorities increase the value of a consistent country-facing governance model that aligns client delivery, institutions, local participation, environmental commitments and executive escalation.

opportunities.title: Regional government and institutional alignment
opportunities.rationale: Wood's regional portfolio spans jurisdictions with distinct national development plans, permitting structures, local-content regimes and state-linked clients. Stronger institutional mapping and executive coordination can reduce fragmentation and keep policy, commercial and project dependencies visible before they affect schedule, cost or stakeholder confidence.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would build a regional stakeholder architecture linking ministries, regulators, national companies, investment agencies and internal project owners, supported by issue registers, commitment tracking and defined escalation routes so external engagement produces timely decisions and accountable follow-through.

opportunities.title: Local value and workforce commitments
opportunities.rationale: Nationalisation targets, supplier development and workforce capability are increasingly tied to contract competitiveness and long-term client relationships across the Gulf and wider region. Delivery requires clear ownership, credible measurement and coordination between business development, procurement, HR, operations and external stakeholders.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would translate local-value commitments into measurable action plans with named owners, evidence requirements and executive reporting, drawing on direct experience coordinating regulators, contractors, communities and internal functions around employment, procurement and social-performance obligations.

opportunities.title: Energy transition stakeholder positioning
opportunities.rationale: Wood's work across gas, methanol, carbon reduction and lower-carbon project delivery sits at the intersection of energy security, industrial policy and emissions management. Clear evidence and disciplined public-sector engagement help connect technical delivery with national transition priorities and client investment cases.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would connect operating evidence, environmental performance and economic contribution with a focused stakeholder agenda for governments, regulators, industry bodies and strategic partners, strengthening the link between project delivery and Wood's broader energy-transition positioning.

opportunities.title: Post-acquisition cross-market governance
opportunities.rationale: Integration into Sidara creates an opportunity to standardise external-risk visibility while preserving the market knowledge required in each jurisdiction. A common governance model for stakeholder commitments and country risks can support faster executive oversight across a broad and changing regional portfolio.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would establish a repeatable country diagnostic covering institutions, regulatory dependencies, local participation, community issues, material commitments and executive escalation, giving regional leadership a consistent view of external risks without removing market-specific accountability.

days_0_30: Map priority countries, clients, ministries, regulators and local-content dependencies.
Review material external commitments and current ownership across active projects.
Identify stakeholder issues with direct schedule, commercial or reputation impact.
days_31_60: Align regional government, project, commercial, sustainability and local-value engagement plans.
Create a single commitment and issue register with named owners and deadlines.
Define executive indicators for institutional confidence, local-value delivery and external risk.
days_61_90: Run focused engagement on priority government, regulatory and client-facing issues.
Embed monthly cross-functional review of commitments and country risks.
Strengthen evidence controls for local-content, sustainability and community commitments.
days_91_180: Scale the governance model across priority Middle East, Africa and Caspian markets.
Measure issue closure, stakeholder response times and commitment performance.
Codify lessons into a repeatable country and stakeholder execution playbook.

potential_impact: Faster resolution of government, regulatory and local-content issues through clear ownership and escalation.
More consistent stakeholder execution across regional projects and client relationships.
Stronger evidence behind local-value and sustainability commitments.
Improved alignment between external engagement, commercial priorities and project delivery.
background_relevance: Director-level responsibility spanning government relations, ESG, corporate affairs, social performance and executive advisory in a regulated multinational resource environment.
Direct engagement with ministries, regulators, public institutions, communities and contractors on permits, commitments and strategic projects.
Experience translating external expectations into cross-functional actions across legal, finance, procurement, operations, environment, HR and executive teams.
Practical work on local participation, environmental-management systems, carbon-data traceability and renewable-energy positioning.
